questions.question: What feedback should the action give? (The spawn will be detached with null stdio either way, so a stray `xdg-open` warning can't corrupt the TUI.)

options.label: Quiet success, loud failure (Recommended)
options.description: No toast when the launcher spawns fine (the file manager window is its own feedback). A Refused toast naming the command and reason when it's missing or exits non-zero — e.g. "Could not open file manager: 'xdg-open' not found".

options.label: Toast on both
options.description: "Opened /path/to/worktree" on success plus the failure toast. Confirms the path, but adds noise to an action you'll use often.

options.label: Fully silent, best-effort
options.description: Mirrors clipboard.rs (failures are silent). Least code, but a headless/SSH session gives you no clue why nothing happened.
